drug_clinical_info.lactation_safety: Excreted in small amounts in breast milk; compatible with breastfeeding.
drug_clinical_info.adult_dosage: 275mg to 550mg PO every 12 hours as needed (or 550mg initially followed by 275mg every 6-8 hours; Max: 1375mg/day).
drug_clinical_info.pediatric_dosage: 10mg/kg/day PO divided into 2 doses for juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children >= 2 years.
drug_clinical_info.hepatic_renal_precautions: Avoid in severe renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min). Monitor renal and hepatic parameters during prolonged therapy.
drug_clinical_info.trimester_considerations: Category C prior to 20 weeks; Category D starting at 20 weeks gestational age (oligohydramnios and premature ductus arteriosus closure).
drug_clinical_info.neonatal_dosage: Safety and efficacy not established in neonates.
drug_clinical_info.geriatric_dosage: Initiate with lowest effective dose (275mg BID); increased risk of GI hemorrhage and renal impairment.
drug_clinical_info.weight_bsa_dosing: 10mg/kg/day in 2 divided doses for pediatric arthritis.
drug_clinical_info.dialysis_considerations: Not dialyzable due to high protein binding (> 99%).
drug_clinical_info.indications_approved: Acute musculoskeletal pain, rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, tendonitis, bursitis, acute gout, primary dysmenorrhea.
drug_clinical_info.indications_common: Migraine headache treatment and prophylaxis, fever, post-operative dental pain.
drug_clinical_info.indications_offlabel: Paget disease of bone, heterotopic ossification prophylaxis.
drug_clinical_info.pharmacology_moa: Reversibly inhibits cyclooxygenase-1 and 2 (COX-1 and COX-2) enzymes, blocking conversion of arachidonic acid to inflammatory prostaglandins.
drug_clinical_info.pharmacokinetics_summary: Rapid and completely absorbed from GI tract; extensive hepatic metabolism via CYP2C9 and CYP1A2.
drug_clinical_info.absorption_bioavailability: Oral Bioavailability: 95%. Peak plasma concentration: 1-2 hours.
drug_clinical_info.distribution_protein_binding: Protein Binding: > 99%. Volume of distribution: 0.16 L/kg.
drug_clinical_info.metabolism_cyp: Extensively metabolized in liver by CYP2C9 and CYP1A2 to 6-O-desmethylnaproxen.
drug_clinical_info.half_life_elimination: Elimination Half-life: 12-17 hours (permits twice-daily dosing). Renal excretion: 95%.
drug_clinical_info.onset_peak_duration: Onset: 30-60 minutes for analgesia. Peak: 1-2 hours. Duration: 12 hours.
drug_clinical_info.contraindications_absolute: Hypersensitivity to naproxen, aspirin, or other NSAIDs; CABG surgery setting; active gastrointestinal bleeding or peptic ulcer disease.
drug_clinical_info.contraindications_relative: Hypertension, congestive heart failure, chronic kidney disease, cirrhosis, history of GI bleed.
drug_clinical_info.boxed_warnings: Boxed Warning: Cardiovascular Risk (MI, Stroke) and Gastrointestinal Risk (Bleeding, Ulceration, Perforation). Naproxen has lowest cardiovascular risk among non-selective NSAIDs.
drug_clinical_info.serious_warnings: Renal toxicity including papillary necrosis and acute interstitial nephritis with long-term use.
drug_clinical_info.cautions: Fluid retention and edema; can worsen pre-existing heart failure.
drug_clinical_info.monitoring_required: Baseline and periodic CBC, renal function (BUN/Creatinine), blood pressure, and occult fecal blood.
drug_clinical_info.side_effects_common: Dyspepsia, heartburn, nausea, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, edema.
drug_clinical_info.side_effects_serious: GI bleeding, peptic ulcer, acute renal failure, severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SJS/TEN).
drug_clinical_info.side_effects_rare_life_threatening: Anaphylaxis, fatal GI perforation, Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
drug_clinical_info.food_interactions: Take with food or milk to minimize gastrointestinal discomfort. Avoid concurrent alcohol.
drug_clinical_info.disease_interactions: Peptic ulcer disease, hypertension, heart failure, renal insufficiency, aspirin-sensitive asthma.
drug_clinical_info.special_populations: Elderly, patients with cardiovascular risk factors, third trimester of pregnancy.
drug_clinical_info.monitoring_parameters: Blood pressure, Serum Creatinine, BUN, Complete Blood Count, LFTs.
drug_clinical_info.administration_instructions: Take with a full glass of water, with or after food. Do not lie down for 15 minutes after taking.
drug_clinical_info.storage_stability: Store at 20-25°C. Protect from light and excessive moisture.
drug_clinical_info.patient_counseling_en: Take with food or milk to avoid upset stomach. Stop taking and call your doctor immediately if you experience dark/black stools, persistent stomach pain, or chest pain.
drug_clinical_info.patient_counseling_professional: Lowest CV risk profile among traditional NSAIDs (ADAPT trial). Take low-dose cardioprotective aspirin 30-60 minutes prior to naproxen.

drug_clinical_info.cautions: May trigger bronchospasm in patients with bronchial asthma or allergic disease.
drug_clinical_info.monitoring_required: LFTs (AST/ALT), renal function, CBC with differential.
drug_clinical_info.side_effects_common: Dyspepsia, abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, pruritus.
drug_clinical_info.side_effects_serious: GI hemorrhage, peptic ulcer, severe nephrotoxicity, hepatic necrosis.
drug_clinical_info.food_interactions: Take preferably with or after food to minimize gastrointestinal discomfort.
drug_clinical_info.disease_interactions: Peptic ulcer disease, ischemic heart disease, peripheral arterial disease, cerebrovascular disease.
drug_clinical_info.special_populations: Elderly patients, patients with cardiovascular risk factors.
drug_clinical_info.monitoring_parameters: Blood pressure, Serum Creatinine, Liver Function Tests.
drug_clinical_info.administration_instructions: Swallow tablets whole with water. Do not crush or chew. Take with or after meals.
drug_clinical_info.storage_stability: Store below 30°C in a dry place.
drug_clinical_info.patient_counseling_en: Take this medicine after meals. Report any stomach pain, nausea, or dark-colored stools to your pharmacist.
drug_clinical_info.patient_counseling_professional: Superior gastrointestinal safety profile compared to diclofenac due to preferential COX-2 inhibition and minimal suppression of gastric mucosal PGE2.

drug_clinical_info.lactation_safety: Compatible with breastfeeding (small amounts in milk).
drug_clinical_info.hepatic_renal_precautions: Contraindicated in severe active liver failure. Reduce max dose to 2000mg/day in chronic alcohol abuse or hepatic insufficiency. In CrCl < 10 mL/min, extend interval to q8h.
drug_clinical_info.trimester_considerations: Safe across all trimesters at recommended doses; avoid excessive duration.
drug_clinical_info.geriatric_dosage: Use lowest effective dose; start with 500mg in frail elderly.
drug_clinical_info.weight_bsa_dosing: Dosed strictly by mg/kg in children.
drug_clinical_info.dialysis_considerations: Slightly dialyzable (HD/PD); no supplemental post-dialysis dose required unless prolonged.
drug_clinical_info.indications_approved: Fever reduction, mild-to-moderate pain (headache, toothache, dysmenorrhea, musculoskeletal pain).
drug_clinical_info.indications_offlabel: Patent ductus arteriosus closure in preterm infants (IV formulation off-label).
drug_clinical_info.pharmacology_moa: Reversibly inhibits central cyclooxygenase (COX-1 & COX-2) pathways in CNS, inhibiting prostaglandin synthesis and elevating pain threshold.
drug_clinical_info.pharmacokinetics_summary: Rapid oral absorption; hepatic glucuronidation and sulfation; minor NAPQI toxic metabolite pathway via CYP2E1 detoxified by glutathione.
drug_clinical_info.absorption_bioavailability: Oral Bioavailability: 88-90%. Peak plasma concentration reached in 30-60 minutes.
drug_clinical_info.distribution_protein_binding: Vd: ~1 L/kg. Low protein binding (10-25%). Crosses placenta and blood-brain barrier.
drug_clinical_info.metabolism_cyp: Metabolized in liver via glucuronidation (55%), sulfation (30%), and CYP2E1 (5-10% NAPQI).
drug_clinical_info.half_life_elimination: Elimination Half-life: 2-3 hours. Renal excretion of metabolites (90% in 24h).
drug_clinical_info.onset_peak_duration: Onset: 15-30 min PO, 5-10 min IV. Peak: 1 hour PO. Duration: 4-6 hours.
drug_clinical_info.contraindications_absolute: Hypersensitivity to paracetamol; severe acute liver disease or active hepatic failure.
drug_clinical_info.contraindications_relative: Chronic alcohol abuse, malnourishment, severe renal impairment (eGFR < 15 mL/min).
drug_clinical_info.boxed_warnings: Overdose Warning: Doses > 4g/day cause fatal acute liver necrosis. N-acetylcysteine antidote required within 8 hours.
drug_clinical_info.serious_warnings: Hepatotoxicity risk in malnourished or chronic alcoholic patients.
drug_clinical_info.cautions: Avoid concurrent paracetamol-containing combination products to prevent accidental overdose.
drug_clinical_info.monitoring_required: Monitor liver function tests (LFTs) if therapy exceeds 10 consecutive days.
drug_clinical_info.side_effects_common: Nausea, rash, headache, constipation (with IV route).
drug_clinical_info.side_effects_serious: Hepatotoxicity, severe cutaneous adverse reactions (Stevens-Johnson syndrome, TEN).
drug_clinical_info.food_interactions: Food slightly delays peak absorption rate but does not reduce overall bioavailability. Avoid heavy alcohol consumption.
drug_clinical_info.disease_interactions: Severe hepatic dysfunction, chronic hepatitis, alcohol dependency, G6PD deficiency.
drug_clinical_info.special_populations: Hepatic insufficiency, chronic alcohol use, pediatric weight-based dosing.
drug_clinical_info.monitoring_parameters: LFTs (AST/ALT, Bilirubin) in prolonged use or overdose, Serum Paracetamol level (Rumack-Matthew nomogram).
drug_clinical_info.administration_instructions: Take with a full glass of water. Can be taken with or without food. Do not crush sustained-release tablets.
drug_clinical_info.storage_stability: Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place. Protect from excessive light and humidity.
drug_clinical_info.patient_counseling_en: Do not take more than 8 tablets (500mg each) in 24 hours. Check labels of cold/flu products so you do not double dose.
drug_clinical_info.patient_counseling_professional: Verify patient total daily dose from all combined OTC and Rx products. Administer IV infusion over 15 minutes.
